clue.text: Part of normal achievement for bookmaker

indicators.note: Part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Someone reckons a modest feat is creditable for a betting-shop proprietor.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft took 'for bookmaker' as the definition; 'for' is only a link, so the definition is 'bookmaker'. 'Bookmaker' suggests a bookie, but here it is the maker of a book of the Bible.
explanation.definitionFit: Malachi is the prophet traditionally credited with writing the last book of the Old Testament, so he is the maker of a book.

clue.text: Girl making a minor error

indicators.note: an error makes a mess of something, so these letters are put wrong

explanation.surface: A young woman commits a small mistake.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a female first name.

clue.text: Mathematician seen in the square in his home town

parts.note: la is French for the, French being the language of his home town
place is French for a town square

explanation.surface: A scholar is spotted in the main plaza of where he grew up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in his home town' says the words are put into the mathematician's own language, French.
explanation.definitionFit: Pierre-Simon Laplace was a French mathematician and astronomer.

clue.text: Study new score including Tchaikovsky's first musical pieces

parts.note: to con is to study

indicators.note: including says one piece goes inside the other
new says the letters of score are given a fresh arrangement
first says only the opening letter of Tchaikovsky's is used

explanation.surface: A student examines a fresh score containing some Tchaikovsky works.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' makes CEROS of SCORE; T goes inside to make CERTOS.
explanation.definitionFit: Concertos are compositions for soloist and orchestra, which are works of music.

clue.text: He appreciated the gravity of the situation in the garden

definitions.text: He appreciated the gravity of the situation in the garden

parts.words: He appreciated the gravity of the situation in the garden
parts.note: the idiom for grasping seriousness is taken literally, about the scientist inspired by a falling apple

explanation.walkthrough: The story goes that a falling apple in his garden led him to the theory of gravitation.
explanation.definitionFit: The English physicist formulated the law of universal gravitation, reputedly after an apple fell.

clue.text: Harbour unsuitable for old vessels, according to Matthew?

definitions.text: unsuitable for old vessels, according to Matthew?
definitions.meaning: in Matthew's Gospel new wine is not put into old bottles, so fresh fortified wine would be unsuitable for old vessels

explanation.walkthrough: Read as two words, the answer is wine that is new; Matthew 9:17 warns against putting new wine in old bottles. 'Vessels' first suggests ships, fitting the harbour.
explanation.definitionFit: A port is a harbour, and this one is also a Welsh seaport name.

clue.text: Head teachers' organisation

definitions.meaning: the National Union of Teachers, a British trade union

explanation.definitionFit: Slang for the skull, and the initials of the National Union of Teachers, a British union.

clue.text: Rustic band accompanying last part of dance

parts.note: accompanying means with

indicators.note: last part of says only the final letter of dance is used

explanation.surface: A country group of musicians plays alongside the end of the dance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'band' suggests musicians; it is a tie.
explanation.definitionFit: A withe is a pliant willow twig used as a tie in country crafts, binding bundles.

clue.text: Anomalous individual left one in remote situation

indicators.note: in says the pieces go inside the other

parts.note: an outer position is a remote one
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: An odd person has abandoned someone in a far-off place.
explanation.definitionFit: Something lying apart from the main body, or a statistical point far from the rest, is atypical.

clue.text: It's a tree prepared for writer's study

indicators.note: prepared says the letters are worked into a new form

explanation.surface: A tree is made ready for an author's research.
explanation.definitionFit: A treatise is a formal written work examining a subject.

clue.text: Record entrant moving right to the front? Sorry!

indicators.note: moving says a letter in the built word is shifted to a new place
to the front says where the shifted letter ends up: at the very start

parts.note: an EP is an extended-play record

explanation.surface: A competitor who shifts to the right of the field apologises.
explanation.walkthrough: EP plus ENTRANT gives EPENTRANT; 'moving' the R 'to the front' gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone sorry for a wrong is penitent, and an exclamation of apology expresses that remorse.

clue.text: Name on jacket? Right

definitions.meaning: the name of a book printed on its dust jacket
a legal entitlement, as to property

explanation.definitionFit: A book's name is printed on its jacket, and a claim of ownership to land is also called this.

clue.text: American people love a guru

parts.note: love is nil in tennis, so the letter O
a guru is a wise teacher, a sage

explanation.surface: A nation is fond of a spiritual teacher.
explanation.definitionFit: The Osage are a Native American nation of the Great Plains, now based in Oklahoma.

clue.text: Person anxious to get on vehicle I steer badly

parts.note: a car is a vehicle

indicators.note: badly says the letters of the words before it are steered into a poor order

explanation.surface: A nervous learner driver confesses to steering the car poorly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'badly' turns I STEER into EERIST. 'Get on' looks like boarding the vehicle but means getting ahead in work.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone ambitious for promotion, putting advancement in work above all else, is described this way.

clue.text: Pen, possibly, holds a Red in this state

indicators.note: possibly says the letters could be arranged another way

explanation.surface: A chicken run might contain a Rhode Island Red, the hen breed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pen' is a farmyard enclosure, part of the picture; the breed of hen named after the state helps.
explanation.definitionFit: Rhode Island is the smallest of the United States, in New England.

clue.text: Soccer players in hospital?

definitions.meaning: attackers playing in the middle of the forward line
a hospital is a place, a centre, with beds in wards

explanation.walkthrough: Split differently, the answer reads 'centre for wards', a fanciful description of a hospital.
explanation.definitionFit: Footballers leading the attack from the middle of the front line hold this position.

clue.text: Banquets in courts characteristic of a good deal?

indicators.note: in says one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: to court someone is to woo them
to banquet is to dine

explanation.surface: Feasting while courting a lover is a fine bargain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'deal' means a bargain on the surface; it is pine or fir timber.
explanation.definitionFit: Deal is softwood timber, so a good piece of it would be marked by the quality of being wood.

clue.text: Most effective medicine stops onset of fatal attack

indicators.note: stops onset of says the start of the word is cut off

parts.note: slaughter is killing, a fatal attack

explanation.surface: The best drug halts the beginning of a deadly seizure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stops onset of' removes the S from SLAUGHTER. The definition alludes to the saying that it is the best medicine.
explanation.definitionFit: The proverb holds that a good chuckle is the best medicine.

clue.text: How chess players regard each other, in general

definitions.text: How chess players regard each other
definitions.meaning: opponents face each other over the chessboard between them

explanation.definitionFit: Opponents sit facing over the board, and the idiom means applying universally to all.

clue.text: Stagger with shock treatment, and return to seat

parts.note: to reel is to stagger
ECT is electroconvulsive therapy

explanation.surface: Someone lurches after electric therapy and goes back to the chair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'seat' suggests a chair; it is a seat in parliament.
explanation.definitionFit: To vote someone back into office returns them to their parliamentary place.

clue.text: Get ready for serial broadcast to East

indicators.note: broadcast says the letters are scattered into a new order

explanation.surface: Prepare for a radio serial to be transmitted eastward.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broadcast' turns SERIAL into REALIS. 'Get ready' means turn into cash.
explanation.definitionFit: To realise assets is to convert them into money, so to obtain cash.

clue.text: Will soon get repetitions eliminated for the President

indicators.note: repetitions eliminated says each doubled letter in the phrase loses one copy

explanation.surface: Someone will shortly have repeats stopped for the head of state.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing one L and one O from WILLSOON leaves the US President Woodrow's surname.
explanation.definitionFit: Woodrow Wilson was the 28th President of the United States.

clue.text: His, perhaps?

parts.note: read not as a possessive but as the plural of the salutation hi, words said on meeting

explanation.walkthrough: 'His' looks like a possessive pronoun; it is several 'hi's.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying 'hi' is a salutation, so a number of 'hi's are welcoming words.

clue.text: Turn up to change position of plant that's lush

indicators.note: Turn up in a down clue says the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: to repot a plant is to move it to a new pot

explanation.surface: Gardener turns up to move a luxuriant plant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lush' looks like an adjective describing the plant; it is a noun, a drunkard.
explanation.definitionFit: A toper is a heavy drinker, a drunkard.

clue.text: Rated intelligence about military group, one from Arab country

indicators.note: about says one piece goes around the other

parts.note: IQ is intelligence quotient, measured intelligence
RA is the Royal Artillery
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone assesses the intelligence on a military unit, part of it from a Middle Eastern state.
explanation.definitionFit: Being of or from Iraq, the Arab state around Baghdad, is what the adjective means.

clue.text: Tether that is restricting ram? Just the opposite

indicators.note: restricting says one piece hems in another
Just the opposite flips the roles, so the ram does the restricting rather than being restricted

parts.note: a tup is a ram, the male sheep
IE is the abbreviation of id est, that is

explanation.surface: Someone asks if a tethered beast is a ram held fast, and is told the reverse.
explanation.walkthrough: Read plainly, the abbreviation would hold the ram; 'Just the opposite' swaps the roles of container and contents.
explanation.definitionFit: To tether an animal is to fasten it with a rope, securing it to a post.

clue.text: Muscular type taking prize at US gathering

indicators.note: gathering says the letters of the words before it are collected into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A bodybuilder wins a trophy at an American meeting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gathering' shuffles PRIZE AT US. 'Muscular type' suggests a bodybuilder; it is a kind of muscle.
explanation.definitionFit: The large back muscle running from neck to shoulder blade is one sort of muscle.

clue.text: Bit of America that Amerigo discovered initially

indicators.note: initially says the first letters of the words are taken

explanation.surface: A part of the New World found by the explorer Amerigo Vespucci at the start.
explanation.definitionFit: Americans use the word for a little amount or small quantity.

clue.text: Part of army, exhausted, withdrew

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a corps of the British Army
exhausted means tired

explanation.surface: A section of the army, worn out, fell back.
explanation.definitionFit: To retreat or go away from a place is a synonym.

clue.text: Record English service in see

parts.note: a disc is a gramophone record
RN is the Royal Navy, one of the armed services

explanation.surface: A record of an English church service held in a bishop's diocese.
explanation.walkthrough: 'see' looks like a bishop's diocese, fitting 'service'; it is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To make out or perceive something is a synonym.
